en.bdb: The Guru-orientated gets up early in the morning and makes others also to do so.
Discarding delusions is equal to bathing at the holy places for him.
Gurmukh carefully and attentively recites the moolmantar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh nihachal hoi ik man dhiaaiaa|

en.bdb: The Gurmukh single-mindedly concentrates upon the Lord.
The red mark of love adorns his forehead.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit_en: pairee pai gur sikh pairee paiaa ||5||

en.bdb: Falling on the feet of the Sikhs of the Guru and thus through his own humility, he makes others surrender to his feet.
